surface: Native monotone drainage leaves within original target owners. Every adjacent leaf pair has its lowest native saddle; one declared effective spill width per pair. No 5m cap, no dropping held receivers.
background: Original local runoff from non-target land is a prescribed external source, not recalculated precipitation. Its original routing and source records are retained separately.
ocean: Fixed sea level 0m; signed transfer, including sea ingress where a native coast is below 0m, appears explicitly in the water ledger.
lake: Existing original bed/initial storage, phase rain/evaporation, and designed350m outlet along the existing ocean path are retained; native bank contacts also exchange with neighbouring ponds.
